Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana' Film Release Date Announced

The makers of the film 'Ramayana', starring Ranbir Kapoor, have announced its release date. The film is scheduled to arrive in theaters on Diwali. Advance booking for the film will commence on Dussehra.
